theses.subject: Gold Miners

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties sits just behind Gold with rank 2, eligible, high score (1.603), and decent breadth (0.833). It shares the precious-metals leadership profile and the same validated trend-gate staying-power backing.
theses.dissent: The margin to the leader is thin (0.167) and this is effectively the same precious-metals complex — it is not an independent thesis. Both themes share a macro driver and could both stall together.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO (proxy for both precious metals themes) breaks below its 50-day trend and breadth falls under 0.7 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are the only non-commodity eligible theme with a clean 'trend' Hurst tag and the highest durability bar (0.67). This offers diversification from the metals leadership while still sitting on the right side of the trend gate — a defensive trend-following lean rather than a momentum call.
evidence: hurst_tag trend — only non-commodity clean trend
theses.dissent: Breadth is weak (0.429) — less than half the constituents are participating — and score is modest (0.745). This may be a narrow leadership driven by a few large-caps rather than a broad sector trend.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO closes below its own 50-day moving average and stays there for 10 consecutive trading days before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
